name: unsafe fn from_parts (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> Self
rule: Allocation sources other than `Vec<T>` are permitted if `ptr` was allocated using the global allocator, the allocation alignment equals the alignment of `T`, the allocated size in bytes equals the size of `T` multiplied by `capacity` and is no larger than `isize::MAX`, `capacity` is the capacity with which `ptr` was allocated, `length` is at most `capacity`, and the first `length` elements are properly initialized values of type `T`.
api: impl < T > alloc::vec::Vec < T > { unsafe fn from_parts (ptr : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> Self }
